jobs.description:
Build the infrastructure behind real AI systems that run.

At WAIYS, you work closely with our AI engineering team to build, maintain, and improve deployment pipelines, cloud infrastructure, automation, and internal tooling for live AI-driven products.

You’ll work with containerization, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and real-time systems powering AI applications such as robotics, agentic AI, and large-scale inference.

About WAIYS

WAIYS is a Norwegian-German tech company on a mission to simplify AI adoption in the real estate industry.

We combine advanced AI software, robust infrastructure, and deep domain expertise to build modular AI SaaS for real estate investors, developers, and managers. Our solutions range from chatbots to advanced analytics to full agentic automations.

Role Overview

As a DevOps Engineer at WAIYS, you will build, maintain, and improve deployment pipelines for our AI systems.

You will work hands-on with containerization, automation, cloud infrastructure, and real-time systems powering AI applications such as robotics, agentic AI, and large-scale inference.

What you’ll work on:

- Create and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab
- Build, test, and maintain Docker images and containerized services.
- Deploying of microservices across cloud environments.
- Maintain internal development tooling, scripts, monitoring dashboards, and environment automation.
- Documentation of DevOps processes, deployment guidelines, and platform maintenance.
- Troubleshoot pipeline failures, container-level issues, access/token problems, and environment
- Design and implement automation solutions using SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Power BI, Power Automate (Flow), and Microsoft Teams to streamline workflows, improve data visibility, and enhance operational efficiency.
- Implementation of security feature to cloud infrastructure
- Contribute to backup and recovery strategy

What you bring:

- A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, IT, or a related field
- 1–2 years of industry experience in DevOps or IT infrastructure
- Strong knowledge of Linux, shell scripting, and system administration
- Hands-on experience with Docker, Git, GitLab or GitHub, and CI/CD concepts
- Familiarity with Python environment setup
- Practical experience with Azure cloud infrastructure
- Knowledge of cloud application security
- Exposure to DevOps, MLOps, cloud automation, or AI workflows
- Ability to work with Microsoft 365 automation tools such as SharePoint, Microsoft Lists, Power BI, Power Automate, and Microsoft Teams
- Strong English communication; German skills are helpful for local collaboration

Nice to have:

- Understanding of AWS or GCP
- Knowledge of Kubernetes and container orchestration
- Familiarity with inference runtimes
- Experience building internal developer tools or automation scripts

How you work

- You are proactive, self-driven, and excited to learn fast
- You work independently and collaborate well with technical teams
- You feel comfortable in a dynamic, fast-paced startup environment

Why join WAIYS:

- Work on live AI-driven systems
- Build infrastructure for real-world AI applications
- Collaborate closely with AI engineers and technical teams
- Gain hands-on experience with modern DevOps stacks
- Contribute to AI adoption in a fast-moving international company

We offer:

- Hybrid-remote work model (within Norway or Germany)
- 30 vacation days
- Flexible working hours
- Company pension scheme
- Employee benefits and perks
- A highly innovative field of activity
- An open company culture that values ideas over titles

jobs.occupation: Principal Research Scientist - Product Development (m/f/d) (Data Scientist)
jobs.description:
As Principal Research Scientist – Formulation Development, you will join Elanco’s Synthetic Technical Development team in Monheim to lead formulation development for animal health drug products across the full product development life cycle.
In this role, you will provide scientific and technical leadership for Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) products and other dosage forms as needed, solve complex formulation challenges, and guide internal teams and external partners from early development through commercial scale-up.

Your Responsibilities:

- Lead the design, development, and optimization of Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) formulations, including tablets and medicated chewables, from enabling formulations and prototype development through final product design and process scale-up and transfer to manufacturing sites.
- Apply advanced formulation and process expertise in granulation (wet and dry), blending, compression, coating, bioavailability enhancement, controlled release, taste masking, and Quality by Design (QbD) to address complex technical challenges.
- Partner cross-functionally with R&D, manufacturing and quality, and regulatory teams to deliver global development milestones for animal health drug products.
- Select and provide technical oversight to external partners, including Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and Contract Development & Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs),, while ensuring compliance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), Health, Safety and Environment (HSE), and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
- Author and review Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls (CMC) technical sections for regulatory submissions, assess new technologies and in-licensing opportunities, and mentor subject matter experts and developing scientists.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

- Education level — Master’s degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, or a related scientific field required; PhD preferred
- A minimum of 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical drug product development and process scale-up with a PhD, or 15 years with a Master’s degree
- Strong experience in Oral Solid Dosage (OSD) formulation development and manufacturing processes, including tabletsand/or chewable dosage forms
- Strong working knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and global regulatory guidelines, including Veterinary International Cooperation on Harmonisation (VICH) and International Council for Harmonisation (ICH)
- Proven success bringing pharmaceutical products from laboratory development to commercial scale
- Leadership and team skills: ability to operate and lead development activities in a global matrix organization
- Excellent written and spoken English

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

- Experience developing additional dosage forms such as liquids, topicals, or parenterals
- Experience in process transfer between R&D and Manufacturing Sites
- Experience selecting and managing external development or manufacturing partners, including CROs, CDOs, or CMOs
- Experience mentoring technical talent and leading subject matter experts in a matrix environment

Additional Information:
Travel: 10–15%
Location: Monheim, Germany

The Senior Associate – Regulatory CMC, Biocides/Pesticides/Topicals/Collars, works cross functionally with Elanco R&D groups, manufacturing and quality to develop global regulatory strategy, authors submissions, oversees submission preparation and meets the reporting requirements for the Authorization and Maintenance of registrations of new animal drugs with global regulatory agencies.  The role is also responsible for supporting renewals, and annual reporting requirements for approved veterinary drug products.  The person must have a strong knowledge of FDA (CVM), EPA, EMA Regulations and ICH/VICH guidelines governing the authorization and post approval compliance of Veterinary Medicinal Products and Biocides/Pesticides.

Your Responsibilities:

- Proven track record of overseeing end to end life cycle management (LCM) of pharmaceutical dosage forms e.g., otic solutions/suspensions, spot-on solutions, pour-on solutions/suspensions and collars
- Design/develop CMC regulatory strategy for geo-expansion of marketed products with a focus on creativity and innovation, maximizing the business benefit balanced with regulatory compliance.
- Maintain a positive collaboration and partnership with internal groups in R&D, Quality, Manufacturing and with global regulatory business partners of Elanco.
- Lead CMC pre-submission preparation and proactively communicate CMC regulatory strategy, key issues and any other critical topics throughout the life cycle in an adequate and timely manner to interdisciplinary project teams, while applying the global strategy into submissions.
- Ensure the required documentation and any content, quality and/or timelines for global submissions are communicated to the appropriate teams and tracked according to the functional procedures
- Author high-quality CMC documentation for submission, applying CMC global regulatory strategies and assuring regulatory compliance and provide training and mentorship to CMC team members, as necessary

What You Need to Succeed:

- Degree in Science (MSc, B.Pharm/M.Pharm, Postgraduate in Vet Sciences etc.,)
- Min. 5 years in Global Regulatory Affairs, CMC (hands on experience with the Registration process of a variety of pharmaceutical dosage forms is desirable)
- Strong knowledge of FDA (CVM), EPA, EMA and ICH/VICH guidelines and regulations governing the authorization and post approval compliance of biocides/pesticides and topical products intended for veterinary use.
- Experience in developing CMC Regulatory Strategy of topical dosage forms such as otic solutions/suspensions, spot-on solutions, pour-on solutions/suspensions, collars, bee-hive strips, etc. in the US, Europe and most of the world countries is preferred.
- Understanding of the cGMP requirements (21 CFR Parts 210 & 211)
- Strong communication skills, both written and oral
- Ability to make decisions when there is no clear right or wrong answer
- Strong organizational skills and an ability to handle multiple projects at different phases of development and life cycle at the same time
- Fluency in English and good German skills

As a Digital Services Business Partner (f/m/d) for Transformer Factories, you act as the key interface between local business stakeholders and Siemens Energy's global IT and Digital Services organizations. Your focus is on strategically evolving the site's digital and IT landscape, driving the implementation of digital and IT initiatives, and ensuring that these services deliver measurable business value.

* Take end-to-end ownership of Digital Services initiatives, IT projects, and IT services at the site
* Align the site's digital and IT landscape with the Siemens Energy IT and Digital Strategy in collaboration with global Business Partners and the IT reference architecture
* Analyze, prioritize, and govern digital and IT demands, including business case development, investment justification, governance, and Go/No-Go decision-making
* Budget Management: Own and manage the site's Digital Services and IT budget, including planning, forecasting, cost control, investment prioritization, and ensuring optimal business value from digital and IT spending

jobs.description:
The opportunity

We are seeking an experienced Legal Counsel – Employment & Labor Law (f/m/x) to lead our Social Affairs function across Germany & CEE (Austria, Romania and Czech Republic). Based in Germany, in this strategic role, you will be the architect of our social dialogue for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic. You will not only provide expert legal advice but also lead direct relationships with Employee Representatives and Works Councils in all four countries. You are responsible for negotiating agreements, ensuring compliance, and fostering a constructive social climate to support the Group’s transformation and growth in the region.

Day-to-day responsibilities

Regional Social Dialogue (DE, AT, RO, CZ)

- Germany (Betriebsrat): Lead negotiations on complex shop agreements (Betriebsvereinbarungen) regarding IT systems, mobile work, and restructuring. Manage co-determinationrights (Mitbestimmung) effectively.
- Austria (Betriebsrat): Lead the relationship with the Austrian Works Council. Navigate the specificities of the Austrian "Social Partnership" and negotiate local shop agreements in compliance with the Arbeitsverfassungsgesetz (ArbVG).
- Romania (Reprezentanții salariaților) and Czech Republic (Odborová organizace): Lead the relationship with the Works Councils.
- Harmonization: Ensure a consistent social strategy across Germany & CEE cluster while respecting local legislative nuances.

Employment Law Advisory

Legal Business Partner: Serve as the primary legal advisor to the HR Country 

- Individual Labor Law: Manage complex individual cases across the region: drafting termination notices, negotiating mutual separation agreements (Aufhebungsverträge / Mutual Termination Agreements), and handling disciplinary measures.
- Contracts: Maintain and update standard employment contract templates for Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic to ensure they remain compliant with the latest local case law.

Restructuring & Strategic Projects

- Transformation Support: Legally structure and execute organizational changes across the region (e.g.,§613a BGB transfers in Germany, AVRAG transfers in Austria).
- Compliance: Roll out Group compliance policies (GDPR, Whistleblowing, Code of Conduct) ensuring they meet the strict data privacy standards of Germany and the specific requirements of the Austrian market.

Litigation Management

- Dispute Resolution: Represent the company in labor court proceedings (Kündigungsschutzklagen) in Germany.
- External Supervision: Select and manage external legal counsel in Austria, Romania and Czech Republic for specific litigation or high-risk cases, ensuring cost control and alignment with Group strategy.

Who are we looking for

Experience & Qualifications

- 8 to 10+ years of experience in Labor Law/Social Affairs, preferably within an international matrix organization, an IT/Consulting firm, or a specialized law firm.
- Works Council Leadership: Mandatory experience leading negotiations with Works Councils.
- You must have deep expertise in the German Betriebsverfassungsgesetz.
- You must have experience or a strong capability to manage Austrian employee representation bodies.
- Regional Scope: Proven ability to manage legal topics across multiple jurisdictions (Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic).

Competencies

- Negotiation Skills: Ability to lead social dialogue in four different legal environments (example: co-determination of Germany).
- Pragmatism: Solution-oriented mindset; you enable business while managing risk.
- Languages: German (Native level) and English (Fluent) are required. French is a plus.

Perks & Benefits

- Regional Responsibility: A key role covering four distinct countries with strategic importance.
- Autonomy: You will be the lead expert for the region Germany, Austria, Romania and Czech Republic, trusted to handle sensitive negotiations with the collaboration of the HR Country Manager.
- Transformation: The opportunity to accompany a high-growth group in structuring its social foundations in the German & CEE market.
